description: Protection of children from abuse, neglect, exploitation and harmful conditions.
scope_definition: City policies affecting children's rights, protection and welfare.
covered_areas: Child protection; neglected children; abandoned children; child-friendly services.
primary_responsibilities: Develop and review protective legislative measures.
notes: This aligns with Manila's stated jurisdiction over children's rights, protection, development and welfare, including abandoned, dependent and neglected children.  RA 9344 likewise establishes a Philippine framework for children at risk and children in conflict with the law.

description: Programs supporting children's development, education, health and welfare.
scope_definition: Local government programs affecting children.
covered_areas: Day-care services; child development; nutrition; recreational programs.
notes: This aligns with Manila's stated jurisdiction over children's rights, protection, development and welfare, including abandoned, dependent and neglected children.  RA 9344 likewise establishes a Philippine framework for children at risk and children in conflict with the law.

description: Matters concerning the status, administration and welfare of city government personnel.
scope_definition: Local legislative matters involving city personnel.
covered_areas: Civil service rules; retirement; pensions; gratuity; personnel organization.
outside_scope: Issuing individual appointments belonging to the appointing authority.
notes: The Manila rules specifically identify Civil Service operations, employee status, retirement/pension/gratuity, professional regulation and confirmation of certain mayoral appointments.

description: Review of appointments and organizational restructuring requiring Sanggunian action.
scope_definition: Confirmation and legislative aspects of city organizational changes.
covered_areas: Department heads; bureau heads; office reorganization.
typical_legislative_matters: Confirmation of a city department head appointment.
outside_scope: Career appointment processes governed by CSC rules.
notes: The Manila rules specifically identify Civil Service operations, employee status, retirement/pension/gratuity, professional regulation and confirmation of certain mayoral appointments.

description: Protection of consumers from unfair, deceptive or illegal business practices.
scope_definition: Local consumer-protection policies within city authority.
covered_areas: Product quality; misleading practices; consumer complaints; business practices.
outside_scope: Cases exclusively under national regulatory agencies or courts.
notes: Manila's official rules expressly include consumer needs, goods, standards, weights, measures, quality control and price stabilization/control.

description: Local matters involving commodity prices, standards, weights and measures.
scope_definition: Protection of consumers in local markets and establishments.
covered_areas: Price regulation; weighing instruments; product standards.
typical_legislative_matters: Regulation of weighing practices in public markets.
outside_scope: National monetary policy or national price-setting authority.
notes: Manila's official rules expressly include consumer needs, goods, standards, weights, measures, quality control and price stabilization/control.

description: Legislative matters concerning cooperative organizations and cooperative development.
scope_definition: Local promotion and support of cooperatives.
covered_areas: Consumer cooperatives; producers' cooperatives; service cooperatives; multipurpose cooperatives.
outside_scope: National registration functions of the CDA.
notes: The Manila rules specifically cover cooperative movements, consumer/producer/marketing/service/multipurpose cooperatives and electric cooperatives registered with the CDA.

description: Engagement of organized civil-society groups in local governance.
scope_definition: Policies concerning legitimate NGOs and people's organizations.
covered_areas: Community organizations; NGO participation; development partnerships.
typical_legislative_matters: Recognition or participation framework for local people's organizations.
notes: The Manila rules specifically cover cooperative movements, consumer/producer/marketing/service/multipurpose cooperatives and electric cooperatives registered with the CDA.

description: Economic development planning and policies for Manila.
scope_definition: City-level economic and socioeconomic development.
covered_areas: Investment; economic planning; local economic growth.
notes: The Manila rules describe this jurisdiction as economic-development planning, socioeconomic studies, policies and strategies.

description: Legislative measures designed to improve economic conditions of Manila residents.
scope_definition: Local development initiatives.
covered_areas: Employment; investment; business development; local economic opportunities.
primary_responsibilities: Review economic studies and development programs.
typical_legislative_matters: Ordinance establishing a city economic-development initiative.
notes: The Manila rules describe this jurisdiction as economic-development planning, socioeconomic studies, policies and strategies.

description: Local legislative matters affecting public elementary and secondary education in Manila.
scope_definition: City responsibilities supporting education.
covered_areas: Public schools; educational facilities; school support.
primary_responsibilities: Coordinate legislative policy with education stakeholders.
notes: The Manila rules explicitly include universities, colleges, public schools, libraries and non-formal/community adult education.

description: Development of libraries and community/non-formal educational programs.
scope_definition: Education services under local government responsibility.
covered_areas: Libraries; adult education; community education.
notes: The Manila rules explicitly include universities, colleges, public schools, libraries and non-formal/community adult education.

description: Planning, construction, repair and maintenance of city infrastructure.
scope_definition: Public works owned, operated or maintained by the city.
covered_areas: Roads; bridges; public buildings; parks; monuments.
outside_scope: Private construction permitting as an executive function.
notes: The Manila rules explicitly include construction, maintenance, repair and safety of public buildings, streets, roads, bridges, parks, playgrounds, monuments, drainage and flood control.

description: Infrastructure measures addressing drainage, flooding and public safety.
scope_definition: City public works related to flood mitigation.
covered_areas: Drainage; flood-control structures; waterways infrastructure.
outside_scope: National infrastructure projects outside city authority.
notes: The Manila rules explicitly include construction, maintenance, repair and safety of public buildings, streets, roads, bridges, parks, playgrounds, monuments, drainage and flood control.

category: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND ECOLOGICAL PRESERVATION AND SANITATION AND ANIMAL WELFARE
description: Protection of Manila's environment and ecological systems.
scope_definition: Local environmental policies and ecological sanitation.
covered_areas: Solid waste; pollution; canals; esteros; ecological preservation.
primary_responsibilities: Develop environmental ordinances and review city waste-management policies.
outside_scope: Environmental permits exclusively administered by national agencies.
notes: Manila's own rules place environmental protection, pollution abatement, garbage collection/disposal and cleaning canals/esteros under the environmental committee.  RA 9003 establishes LGU responsibility in ecological solid-waste management.

category: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND ECOLOGICAL PRESERVATION AND SANITATION AND ANIMAL WELFARE
description: Public sanitation and humane treatment of animals within city programs.
scope_definition: Local sanitation and animal-welfare measures.
covered_areas: Sanitation; animal control; responsible ownership; stray-animal management.
primary_responsibilities: Review local sanitation and animal-welfare regulations.
typical_legislative_matters: Ordinance establishing responsible pet ownership requirements.
outside_scope: National wildlife regulation or veterinary licensing.
notes: Manila's own rules place environmental protection, pollution abatement, garbage collection/disposal and cleaning canals/esteros under the environmental committee.  RA 9003 establishes LGU responsibility in ecological solid-waste management.

description: Policies supporting family welfare, family relationships and responsible parenthood.
scope_definition: Local programs affecting family stability and welfare.
covered_areas: Family welfare; parenting; family development.
outside_scope: Judicial determination of marriage, annulment or custody.
notes: The Manila rules identify population/family planning, family rights and responsibilities, quality of family life and youth moral, physical, intellectual and social development.

description: Community programs promoting responsible citizenship and positive values.
scope_definition: Non-coercive educational and community development initiatives.
covered_areas: Values education; family responsibility; community participation.
typical_legislative_matters: Values-formation program for families and communities.
outside_scope: Religious doctrine or compulsory religious instruction.
notes: The Manila rules identify population/family planning, family rights and responsibilities, quality of family life and youth moral, physical, intellectual and social development.

description: Local policies concerning public health, hygiene and preventive healthcare.
scope_definition: Health services within city governmental responsibility.
covered_areas: Public-health programs; clinics; health centers; disease prevention.
primary_responsibilities: Review health policies and funding needs.
outside_scope: Professional medical judgment concerning individual patients.
notes: Manila's rules expressly include public health, hygiene, sanitation, hospitals, clinics, medical centers, crematoria, memorials and cemeteries.

description: Legislative matters concerning city hospitals, clinics and related facilities.
scope_definition: Local health facilities and services.
covered_areas: Hospitals; clinics; medical centers; cemeteries; crematoria.
primary_responsibilities: Review policies concerning city health facilities.
notes: Manila's rules expressly include public health, hygiene, sanitation, hospitals, clinics, medical centers, crematoria, memorials and cemeteries.

category: HOUSING, LAND, URBAN PLANNING DEVELOPMENT AND RESETTLEMENT
description: Housing and resettlement policies for residents requiring secure and adequate shelter.
scope_definition: City housing, relocation and resettlement.
covered_areas: Socialized housing; relocation; informal settlements; urban poor housing.
outside_scope: Private landlord-tenant disputes under national law.
notes: The Manila rules expressly cover housing, urban land reform, planning, development, resettlement, subdivisions, zoning and urban-poor concerns.

category: HOUSING, LAND, URBAN PLANNING DEVELOPMENT AND RESETTLEMENT
description: Urban land use, zoning and development planning.
scope_definition: City planning and land-development policy.
covered_areas: Zoning; subdivisions; urban land reform; development planning.
outside_scope: Registration of land titles, which belongs to national agencies.
notes: The Manila rules expressly cover housing, urban land reform, planning, development, resettlement, subdivisions, zoning and urban-poor concerns.

description: ICT systems and digital transformation of city-government services.
scope_definition: City information systems and digital public services.
covered_areas: E-government; digital records; online services; government information systems.
primary_responsibilities: Review ICT policies and digital-government initiatives.
notes: RA 10173 requires protection of personal information and applies to government and private-sector processing.

description: Government information management, digital communication and responsible use of technology.
scope_definition: ICT-related legislative policy affecting city government.
covered_areas: Information systems; cybersecurity policy; digital records; data governance.
primary_responsibilities: Establish policy frameworks while respecting national law.
notes: RA 10173 requires protection of personal information and applies to government and private-sector processing.

description: Relations between Manila and foreign cities or local governments.
scope_definition: Local international cooperation.
covered_areas: Sister-city arrangements; cultural exchange; institutional cooperation.
notes: Manila's rules specifically identify social, cultural, economic, health, labor and tourism relations with foreign cities and sister-city relationships.

description: Social, cultural, economic, health, labor and tourism cooperation with foreign cities.
scope_definition: Local-government international relations.
covered_areas: Cultural exchanges; technical cooperation; economic cooperation.
typical_legislative_matters: Memorandum of understanding with a foreign local government.
notes: Manila's rules specifically identify social, cultural, economic, health, labor and tourism relations with foreign cities and sister-city relationships.

description: Local legislative measures protecting fundamental human rights.
scope_definition: Human-rights concerns within local-government jurisdiction.
covered_areas: Rights protection; discrimination concerns; assistance to victims.
typical_legislative_matters: Resolution supporting a city human-rights protection program.
notes: Manila's official jurisdiction includes human-rights protection, assistance to victims and families, and free legal assistance to the urban poor.

description: Assistance mechanisms for residents experiencing rights violations or legal vulnerability.
scope_definition: Local support and referral mechanisms.
covered_areas: Victims; indigent residents; legal assistance.
typical_legislative_matters: City legal-assistance program for indigent residents.
outside_scope: Practicing law or deciding court cases.
notes: Manila's official jurisdiction includes human-rights protection, assistance to victims and families, and free legal assistance to the urban poor.

description: Local employment and manpower-development policies.
scope_definition: City programs promoting employment and workforce readiness.
covered_areas: Job placement; training; manpower development.
notes: The Manila rules expressly cover labor, employment, manpower, human-resources development, industrial peace, labor education, recruitment, training and placement.  RA 11058 establishes national occupational safety and health requirements.

description: Local policies supporting decent work and harmonious employer-worker relations.
scope_definition: Local legislative measures within city authority.
covered_areas: Labor education; occupational safety awareness; employment statistics.
primary_responsibilities: Recommend policies and coordinate with appropriate agencies.
notes: The Manila rules expressly cover labor, employment, manpower, human-resources development, industrial peace, labor education, recruitment, training and placement.  RA 11058 establishes national occupational safety and health requirements.

description: Review of the legality and validity of proposed city ordinances and resolutions.
scope_definition: Legal consistency of legislative measures.
covered_areas: Ordinances; resolutions; amendments; codification.
primary_responsibilities: Examine legal basis and identify conflicts with existing law.
typical_legislative_matters: Legal review of proposed regulatory ordinance.
notes: The Manila rules expressly include legality/validity of ordinances, city contracts, acts/deeds of officials and codification of ordinances.

description: Legislative review of contracts and legal instruments involving the City.
scope_definition: Leases, loans, donations and other city agreements.
covered_areas: Contracts; leases; donations; city legal instruments.
typical_legislative_matters: Ordinance authorizing a city lease agreement.
notes: The Manila rules expressly include legality/validity of ordinances, city contracts, acts/deeds of officials and codification of ordinances.

description: Local programs providing income-generating opportunities for Manila residents.
scope_definition: City-supported livelihood development.
covered_areas: Microenterprise; livelihood assistance; skills-based enterprises.
notes: Manila's rules specifically identify organized livelihood programs, handicrafts and cottage industries.

description: Promotion of local handicrafts and small-scale cottage industries.
scope_definition: Local economic livelihood development.
covered_areas: Handicrafts; home-based enterprises; cottage industries.
notes: Manila's rules specifically identify organized livelihood programs, handicrafts and cottage industries.

description: Regulation, management and improvement of city public markets.
scope_definition: Public-market facilities and vendor operations.
covered_areas: Market facilities; stalls; vendors; sanitation.
notes: The Manila rules expressly cover public-market and slaughterhouse construction/operation and regulation of vendors/stallholders.

description: Regulation of street vendors/hawkers and city slaughterhouse operations.
scope_definition: Local regulation of these city-managed economic facilities.
covered_areas: Hawkers; vendors; slaughterhouses; stallholders.
notes: The Manila rules expressly cover public-market and slaughterhouse construction/operation and regulation of vendors/stallholders.

description: Local programs supporting Manila residents who are migrant or overseas workers.
scope_definition: City-level welfare and support services.
covered_areas: OFW assistance; family support; reintegration.
notes: The Manila rules identify the OFW committee's jurisdiction as welfare, employment and recruitment of overseas Filipino workers.

description: Local measures addressing illegal recruitment risks and migrant-worker welfare.
scope_definition: City information, assistance and referral mechanisms.
covered_areas: Recruitment awareness; migrant-worker assistance; reintegration.
primary_responsibilities: Coordinate local programs with national agencies.
outside_scope: Licensing of recruitment agencies by national authorities.
notes: The Manila rules identify the OFW committee's jurisdiction as welfare, employment and recruitment of overseas Filipino workers.

description: Legislative monitoring of city departments and offices.
scope_definition: Information gathering and review of city-government operations.
covered_areas: Department programs; service delivery; resource utilization.
primary_responsibilities: Request reports, conduct hearings and monitor implementation.
typical_legislative_matters: Oversight hearing on implementation of a city program.
notes: Manila's rules define Oversight as gathering information and overseeing city departments to promote efficient use of city resources.

description: Monitoring whether approved city programs are implemented efficiently.
scope_definition: Legislative oversight rather than operational control.
covered_areas: Projects; services; resource utilization; implementation.
primary_responsibilities: Evaluate reports and recommend corrective legislation.
typical_legislative_matters: Oversight inquiry into delayed implementation of a city project.
notes: Manila's rules define Oversight as gathering information and overseeing city departments to promote efficient use of city resources.

description: Management-policy review concerning city-owned patrimonial properties.
scope_definition: Inventory, valuation and potential utilization of city properties.
covered_areas: City-owned land/buildings; property inventory; utilization.
primary_responsibilities: Study property utilization and recommend appropriate action.
typical_legislative_matters: Recommendation for productive use of a city-owned property.
notes: This is especially well-supported by actual Manila records: the City Council has enacted measures concerning disposal and leasing of city-owned patrimonial properties.  The committee's official jurisdiction also covers inventory, market-value assessment, lease rentals and disposal recommendations.

jurisdiction_name: Lease and Disposal of City Property
description: Review of proposed leasing or disposal of city-owned patrimonial property.
scope_definition: Legislative authorization and policy concerning city property.
covered_areas: Lease rentals; public bidding; disposal; property valuation.
typical_legislative_matters: Authority to dispose of a city-owned property through public bidding.
notes: This is especially well-supported by actual Manila records: the City Council has enacted measures concerning disposal and leasing of city-owned patrimonial properties.  The committee's official jurisdiction also covers inventory, market-value assessment, lease rentals and disposal recommendations.

category: POLICE, PEACE AND ORDER, FIRE AND PUBLIC SAFETY
description: Local policies concerning public order, policing coordination and community safety.
scope_definition: City legislative measures supporting peace and order.
covered_areas: Police coordination; civil defense; crime prevention.
outside_scope: Direct operational command of national police units beyond legally granted local authority.
notes: Manila's rules cover civil defense, police agencies, fire stations/facilities, city jails and drug prevention/control.

category: POLICE, PEACE AND ORDER, FIRE AND PUBLIC SAFETY
description: Measures concerning fire prevention, emergency preparedness and public safety.
scope_definition: City facilities and policies supporting public safety.
covered_areas: Fire safety; emergency response; disaster preparedness; public safety.
typical_legislative_matters: Ordinance strengthening fire-safety requirements for city facilities.
outside_scope: National fire-code enforcement reserved to BFP.
notes: Manila's rules cover civil defense, police agencies, fire stations/facilities, city jails and drug prevention/control.

description: Rules governing the proceedings and legislative business of the Sanggunian.
scope_definition: Internal parliamentary procedure.
covered_areas: Agenda; calendar; committee referrals; parliamentary rules.
typical_legislative_matters: Amendment to the Council's Internal Rules of Procedure.
notes: The Manila rules specifically place parliamentary rules and the duties, conduct, rights, privileges, dignity and integrity of Sanggunian members within this committee.

description: Matters concerning the conduct, privileges, dignity and integrity of Council members.
scope_definition: Ethical and procedural standards applicable to the Sanggunian.
covered_areas: Member conduct; privileges; decorum; ethics.
primary_responsibilities: Examine ethics-related matters under Council rules.
typical_legislative_matters: Ethics complaint involving a Council member's conduct.
notes: The Manila rules specifically place parliamentary rules and the duties, conduct, rights, privileges, dignity and integrity of Sanggunian members within this committee.

description: Local policies promoting scientific research and technological advancement.
scope_definition: City-level science and technology development.
covered_areas: Research; innovation; technical development.
outside_scope: National science policy exclusively administered by national agencies.
notes: The Manila rules expressly identify scientific and technological research, development and advancement.

description: Application of science and technology to improve city services and economic development.
scope_definition: Local innovation initiatives.
covered_areas: Smart-city technology; research partnerships; technological innovation.
primary_responsibilities: Review proposals for technology-enabled public services.
notes: The Manila rules expressly identify scientific and technological research, development and advancement.

description: Programs, benefits, protection and welfare of senior citizens.
scope_definition: Local implementation/support of senior-citizen policies.
covered_areas: Senior benefits; accessibility; social programs; OSCA.
notes: Manila's rules expressly give this committee general jurisdiction over programs, activities, benefits, protection, welfare, rights, care and support for senior citizens and persons with disabilities.

description: Protection, accessibility and inclusion of persons with disabilities.
scope_definition: City policies promoting equal access and participation.
covered_areas: Accessibility; disability services; inclusion.
primary_responsibilities: Review city programs and infrastructure policies.
outside_scope: Medical diagnosis or national disability certification.
notes: Manila's rules expressly give this committee general jurisdiction over programs, activities, benefits, protection, welfare, rights, care and support for senior citizens and persons with disabilities.

description: Social services for disadvantaged, vulnerable and low-income residents.
scope_definition: City social-welfare programs.
covered_areas: Food; clothing; shelter; social assistance.
outside_scope: Direct case management of individual beneficiaries.
notes: Manila's rules include social services, day-care/reformation facilities, food, clothing, shelter and education programs for disadvantaged residents, and assistance to disaster victims.

description: Assistance programs for residents affected by disasters and other emergencies.
scope_definition: Local social-welfare response.
covered_areas: Disaster assistance; rehabilitation; vulnerable families.
notes: Manila's rules include social services, day-care/reformation facilities, food, clothing, shelter and education programs for disadvantaged residents, and assistance to disaster victims.

description: Development and promotion of Manila as a tourism destination.
scope_definition: City tourism policy and local tourist establishments/sites.
covered_areas: Tourist destinations; tourism promotion; visitor services.
notes: Manila's rules separately identify tourism and Arts & Culture, including promotion of tourism, tourist establishments, cultural heritage, museums and city-administered theaters.

description: Protection and promotion of Manila's cultural and artistic heritage.
scope_definition: Local museums, theaters, cultural programs and heritage resources.
covered_areas: Cultural heritage; museums; theaters; arts programs.
outside_scope: National heritage designation exclusively reserved for national authorities.
notes: Manila's rules separately identify tourism and Arts & Culture, including promotion of tourism, tourist establishments, cultural heritage, museums and city-administered theaters.

description: Promotion of commerce, trade and industry within Manila.
scope_definition: Local business climate and economic activity.
covered_areas: Commerce; industry; business development.
notes: The Manila rules identify promotion, development and regulation of the city's business climate, commerce, trade and industry.

description: Local regulatory measures concerning trade and industrial activities.
scope_definition: City-level regulatory authority.
covered_areas: Business operations; regulatory standards; industry promotion.
notes: The Manila rules identify promotion, development and regulation of the city's business climate, commerce, trade and industry.

description: Regulation and policy concerning local land transportation.
scope_definition: City-level transportation systems and traffic management.
covered_areas: Public utility vehicles; tricycles; terminals; traffic rules.
outside_scope: National vehicle registration and driver's licensing.
notes: The Manila rules include land, sea and air transportation, ports, public utilities/facilities, parking and traffic rules.

description: Local transportation infrastructure and traffic-management policies.
scope_definition: Roads, parking and transportation facilities under city authority.
covered_areas: Parking; traffic regulations; transport facilities.
notes: The Manila rules include land, sea and air transportation, ports, public utilities/facilities, parking and traffic rules.

description: Policies addressing housing and living conditions of economically disadvantaged urban residents.
scope_definition: Local urban-poor development and housing support.
covered_areas: Informal settlements; housing; basic services.
outside_scope: Judicial resolution of land ownership disputes.
notes: Manila's official rules specifically cover assistance to impoverished citizens, housing/feeding programs, and upliftment and empowerment of urban-poor residents.

description: Programs empowering impoverished residents through social and economic opportunities.
scope_definition: Local assistance and development.
covered_areas: Livelihood; feeding; housing; basic services.
typical_legislative_matters: Community livelihood program for an urban-poor settlement.
outside_scope: Direct enforcement against individual street dwellers.
notes: Manila's official rules specifically cover assistance to impoverished citizens, housing/feeding programs, and upliftment and empowerment of urban-poor residents.

description: Local policy concerning essential utility services.
scope_definition: City-level regulation of utilities within local authority.
covered_areas: Water; electricity; communications.
typical_legislative_matters: Local policy concerning utility service provision.
notes: Manila's rules explicitly cover water, electricity, motorized/non-motorized tricycles, communication services and city franchise grants/amendments.

description: Granting or amendment of franchises within the City's lawful authority.
scope_definition: Local franchises and privileges granted by the city.
covered_areas: Local transport franchises; utility-related franchises; communication services.
notes: Manila's rules explicitly cover water, electricity, motorized/non-motorized tricycles, communication services and city franchise grants/amendments.

description: Local taxation, revenue generation, fees and charges.
scope_definition: City's fiscal and revenue-raising powers.
covered_areas: Local taxes; fees; charges; revenue measures.
typical_legislative_matters: Amendment to a local tax or fee ordinance.
notes: The Manila rules expressly include taxation, revenues, fees, borrowing, credit, bonded indebtedness, and real-property assessment and valuation.  RA 7160 gives LGUs authority to create revenue sources and impose taxes, fees and charges subject to statutory limitations.

description: Financial and property-valuation matters affecting city revenues.
scope_definition: Local fiscal policy and real-property valuation.
covered_areas: Real-property assessment; valuation; borrowing; credit; bonded indebtedness.
outside_scope: Monetary policy of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
notes: The Manila rules expressly include taxation, revenues, fees, borrowing, credit, bonded indebtedness, and real-property assessment and valuation.  RA 7160 gives LGUs authority to create revenue sources and impose taxes, fees and charges subject to statutory limitations.

description: Local measures protecting women's rights, safety and welfare.
scope_definition: City programs and policies addressing women's protection and participation.
covered_areas: Women's rights; protection; access to services.
notes: The Manila rules specifically identify women's protection, rights and responsibilities as a committee jurisdiction.

description: Programs promoting women's social, economic and civic participation.
scope_definition: Local development policies affecting women.
covered_areas: Economic empowerment; participation; support services.
notes: The Manila rules specifically identify women's protection, rights and responsibilities as a committee jurisdiction.

category: YOUTH VALUES FORMATION AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
description: Programs supporting the moral, physical, intellectual and social development of Manila's youth.
scope_definition: Local youth-development policies.
covered_areas: Values formation; youth programs; civic participation; youth welfare.
outside_scope: Political indoctrination or compulsory religious instruction.

category: YOUTH VALUES FORMATION AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
description: Development of sports programs, facilities and opportunities for young people.
scope_definition: Local sports-development policies.
covered_areas: Sports facilities; competitions; training; youth athletics.
primary_responsibilities: Review sports programs and facility requirements.
typical_legislative_matters: City sports-development program or sports-facility improvement ordinance.
